entities.name: Valki
entities.description: Skoti god of lies and deceit, brother of Toralf and Halvar and child of Alrund.

entities.name: Toralf
entities.description: God of fury deceived by Valki.

entities.name: Hall of Gods
entities.description: Hall moved from the realm of the gods to Istfell.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: Planeswalker who impersonated Valki on Kaldheim to research the World Tree.

entities.name: Karfell
entities.description: Place where the real Valki was imprisoned.

entities.name: King Narfi
entities.description: King whose palace dungeon held Valki.

entities.name: Esika
entities.description: God of the World Tree who rejected Tibalt.

events.summary: Valki deceives Toralf, who magically transports the Hall of Gods to Istfell.
events.quote: causing the god of fury to magically transport the Hall of Gods

events.summary: Tibalt deceives Valki and binds him in magical chains in King Narfi's dungeon, then impersonates him.
events.quote: Tibalt deceived Valki and bound him in magical chains

events.summary: Tibalt, as Valki, tries to ingratiate himself with Esika but is rebuffed.
events.quote: the god of the World Tree wanted nothing to do with him

relations.quote: impersonated by the planeswalker Tibalt to wreak havoc on Kaldheim
Valki is referred to as a brother of both Toralf and Halvar
